name: Salmon River (Salmon)
blurb: The upper Salmon River between the City of Salmon and North Fork, with designated boating access and a Highway 93 shuttle.

sections.notes: Use the City of Salmon Island Park ramps and the designated IDFG access at North Fork, with a Highway 93 shuttle. North Fork is at the North Fork tributary, not the Middle Fork confluence. Check current flows, obstructions and usable landings before a trip.
sections.routeReview: The river changes around gravel bars and islands. The access areas are shown, but a dependable dotted course for the full stretch is still being checked.

notices.title: Daylight takeout access
notices.text: North Fork boat access is available through an Idaho Fish and Game/private land lease and is for daylight use only. Adjacent campsites and picnic sites are private. Island Park in Salmon is open 6 a.m.–10 p.m.
notices.sourceName: Idaho Fish and Game — North Fork and Island Park
